f.title: Notify in-country SAEs, SARs and SUSARs from clinical trials to OGITT/INS
f.statement: Serious adverse events, serious adverse reactions and suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions occurring in Peru in clinical trials must be notified by the sponsor to the General Office of Research and Technology Transfer (OGITT) of the National Institute of Health (INS), in accordance with the definitions and time frames of the Clinical Trials Regulation, DS 021-2017-SA (Art. 110(a)).
f.clause: Notificación de eventos adversos serios, reacciones adversas serias y sospechas de reacciones adversas serias e inesperadas
f.applicability: Clinical trials conducted in Peru; events occurring in the country

rows.actor: Sponsor or contract research organisation (patrocinador / OIC)
rows.quote: Los eventos adversos serios, reacciones adversas serias y sospechas de reacciones adversas serias e inesperadas ocurridos en el país, deben ser notificados por el patrocinador a la Oficina General de Investigación y Transferencia Tecnológica (OGITT) del Instituto Nacional de Salud (INS), de acuerdo con las definiciones y los plazos especificados en el Reglamento de ensayos clínicos, DS 021-2017-SA (art. 110, inciso a).
rows.location: Notificación de eventos adversos serios, reacciones adversas serias y sospechas de reacciones adversas serias e inesperadas
rows.review_note: Review: faithful; deben = Mandatory. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: time frame in next row.
rows.quote_en: Serious adverse events, serious adverse reactions and suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions occurring in the country must be notified by the sponsor to the General Office of Research and Technology Transfer (OGITT) of the National Institute of Health (INS), in accordance with the definitions and time frames specified in the Clinical Trials Regulation, DS 021-2017-SA (art. 110, subsection a).

f.title: Notify in-country SAEs, SARs and SUSARs within 7 calendar days of sponsor awareness
f.statement: All serious adverse events, serious adverse reactions and suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions must be notified by the sponsor/CRO as soon as possible and within a maximum of seven (7) calendar days from when the sponsor becomes aware of the fact; failure to do so is an infringement of DS 021-2017-SA (Art. 131(e)).
f.clause: Notificación de eventos adversos serios, reacciones adversas serias y sospechas de reacciones adversas serias e inesperadas

rows.actor: Sponsor or contract research organisation (patrocinador / OIC)
rows.deadline: As soon as possible, at the latest 7 calendar days from sponsor awareness
rows.quote: Todos los eventos adversos serios, reacciones adversas serias y sospechas de reacciones adversas serias e inesperadas, deben ser notificadas por el patrocinador / OIC lo más pronto posible, en un plazo máximo de siete (7) días calendario, en cuanto el patrocinador tome conocimiento del hecho, de lo contrario, sería una infracción al DS 021-2017-SA (artículo 131, inciso e).
rows.location: Notificación de eventos adversos serios, reacciones adversas serias y sospechas de reacciones adversas serias e inesperadas
rows.review_note: Review: origin domestic follows the preceding paragraph (events occurring in the country). Re-translation agrees. Double-check: deben = Mandatory; 7 calendar days exact.
rows.quote_en: All serious adverse events, serious adverse reactions and suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions must be notified by the sponsor / CRO as soon as possible, within a maximum period of seven (7) calendar days, as soon as the sponsor becomes aware of the fact; otherwise, it would be an infringement of DS 021-2017-SA (article 131, subsection e).

deadline_rule.clock_start: en cuanto el patrocinador tome conocimiento del hecho
deadline_rule.applies_to: SAEs, serious adverse reactions and SUSARs occurring in Peru in clinical trials

f.title: Enter SAE reports electronically in REAS-NET (form FOR-OGITT-046), then print and file with INS
f.statement: SAE data must be entered electronically in the REAS-NET database using electronic form FOR-OGITT-046 (access with user name and password); after completing the electronic form it must be printed and sent to the INS Document Processing Office.
f.clause: Notificación de eventos adversos serios, reacciones adversas serias y sospechas de reacciones adversas serias e inesperadas

rows.actor: Sponsor or contract research organisation (patrocinador / OIC)
rows.quote: Ingrese los datos electrónicamente, a través de la base de datos REAS-NET, utilizando el formato electrónico FOR-OGITT-046 (Haga clic aquí usando el nombre de usuario y la contraseña). Después de completar el formulario electrónico, debe imprimirse y enviarse a la Oficina de Trámite Documentario del INS.
rows.location: Notificación de eventos adversos serios, reacciones adversas serias y sospechas de reacciones adversas serias e inesperadas
rows.review_note: Review: imperative + debe = Mandatory. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Enter the data electronically, through the REAS-NET database, using the electronic form FOR-OGITT-046 (click here using the user name and password). After completing the electronic form, it must be printed and sent to the INS Document Processing Office.

f.title: Complete the initial SAE report within the next 8 calendar days, then send follow-up and final reports
f.statement: Where necessary, the sponsor completes the information of the initial report within the following eight (8) calendar days; otherwise it must send follow-up reports. When follow-up is complete a final report is sent, and the blind is broken if applicable.
f.clause: Notificación de eventos adversos serios, reacciones adversas serias y sospechas de reacciones adversas serias e inesperadas

rows.actor: Sponsor or contract research organisation (patrocinador / OIC)
rows.deadline: 8 calendar days following the initial report
rows.quote: Completará, de ser necesario, la información del reporte inicial, dentro de siguientes los ocho (8) días calendarios, de lo contrario deberá remitir informes de seguimiento. Cuando se complete el seguimiento, se enviará un informe final. Se abrirá el ciego si corresponde.
rows.location: Notificación de eventos adversos serios, reacciones adversas serias y sospechas de reacciones adversas serias e inesperadas
rows.review_note: Review: clock start is the initial report (the text says "the following eight days"). Double-check: deberá = Mandatory; clock start wording approximate.
rows.quote_en: It will complete, if necessary, the information of the initial report within the following eight (8) calendar days; otherwise it shall send follow-up reports. When the follow-up is completed, a final report will be sent. The blind will be broken if applicable.

f.title: Fill the SAE e-form completely, in chronological order, coding with WHO-ART
f.statement: The electronic form must be filled with complete data, without blank fields, with a narrative in chronological order; the correct term must be used for the SAE, looking terms up in the WHO Adverse Reaction Terminology dictionary (WHO-ART) included in the system.
f.clause: Notificación de eventos adversos serios ... (Se debe tener en cuenta lo siguiente)

rows.actor: Sponsor or contract research organisation (patrocinador / OIC)
rows.quote: Llene el formulario electrónico con datos completos, no deje espacios en blanco y siga un orden cronológico en la narrativa. Use el término correcto para nombrar el EAS, busque los términos en el Diccionario de Terminología de Reacción Adversa de la OMS (WHO-ART) incluido en el sistema.
rows.location: Notificación de eventos adversos serios ... (Se debe tener en cuenta lo siguiente)
rows.review_note: Review: introduced by "Se debe tener en cuenta lo siguiente" = Mandatory. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Fill in the electronic form with complete data, do not leave blank spaces and follow a chronological order in the narrative. Use the correct term to name the SAE; look up the terms in the WHO Adverse Reaction Terminology dictionary (WHO-ART) included in the system.

f.title: Request corrections to REAS-NET SAE reports by a justified document via INS
f.statement: If the notifier finds that an SAE report sent through REAS-NET contains incorrect information, the change must be requested by sending a document justifying the reasons through the INS Document Processing Office.
f.clause: Notificación de eventos adversos serios ... (Se debe tener en cuenta lo siguiente)

rows.quote: En el caso de que el notificante identifique que el reporte de eventos adversos serios, enviado a través de REAS-NET, tiene información incorrecta, se debe solicitar el cambio enviando un documento justificando los motivos, a través de la Oficina de Trámite Documentario del INS
rows.location: Notificación de eventos adversos serios ... (Se debe tener en cuenta lo siguiente)
rows.quote_en: If the notifier identifies that the serious adverse event report sent through REAS-NET contains incorrect information, the change must be requested by sending a document justifying the reasons, through the INS Document Processing Office

f.title: Request cancellation of an SAE report only exceptionally, by a justified document
f.statement: In exceptional cases where cancellation of a report must be requested, a document justifying the reasons must be sent through the INS Document Processing Office.
f.clause: Notificación de eventos adversos serios ... (Se debe tener en cuenta lo siguiente)

rows.quote: En casos excepcionales, en los que es necesario solicitar la cancelación del informe, se debe enviar un documento que justifique los motivos, a través de la Oficina de Trámite Documentario del INS.
rows.location: Notificación de eventos adversos serios ... (Se debe tener en cuenta lo siguiente)
rows.quote_en: In exceptional cases in which it is necessary to request the cancellation of the report, a document justifying the reasons must be sent through the INS Document Processing Office.

f.title: Report pregnancies in clinical trials to OGITT/INS on form FOR-OGITT-047 (print and CD)
f.statement: The principal investigator must notify the sponsor or CRO of the pregnancy of a female trial subject or of the partner of a trial subject as soon as possible within the terms of the clinical trial regulations. The sponsor or CRO must report to OGITT/INS using form FOR-OGITT-047 "Notification of Pregnancy and of the Newborn in Clinical Studies" and send it in printed form and on CD through the INS Document Processing Office; the form cannot be submitted through the virtual system.
f.applicability: Pregnancy of a female subject or of the partner of a male subject in a clinical trial

rows.actor: Sponsor or CRO (investigator notifies the sponsor)
rows.quote: El patrocinador o CRO deben informar a OGITT / INS utilizando el formato FOR-OGITT-047 "Notificación del Embarazo y del Recién Nacido en Estudios Clínicos" (Haga clic aquí ) y enviarlo en formato impreso y en CD a través de la Oficina de Trámite Documentario del INS. No se puede acceder a este formato por medio del sistema virtual.
rows.review_note: Review: investigator duty kept in statement as context (preceding sentence). No fixed time limit stated. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor or CRO must report to OGITT / INS using form FOR-OGITT-047 "Notification of Pregnancy and of the Newborn in Clinical Studies" (click here) and send it in printed form and on CD through the INS Document Processing Office. This form cannot be accessed through the virtual system.

f.title: Notify international SUSARs and serious ADRs to OGITT/INS quarterly or six-monthly
f.statement: SUSARs and serious adverse reactions occurring internationally must be notified by the sponsor or CRO to OGITT/INS quarterly or six-monthly, as applicable (DS 021-2017-SA Art. 110(c)).
f.clause: Sospecha de Reacciones adversas serias e inesperadas (SUSAR) internacionales
f.applicability: SUSARs and serious ADRs occurring outside Peru

rows.actor: Sponsor or contract research organisation (patrocinador / OIC)
rows.quote: Los SUSARs y las reacciones adversas serias ocurridas internacionalmente deben ser notificadas por el patrocinador o CRO a OGITT / INS, trimestral o semestralmente, según corresponda. DS 021-2017-SA (artículo 110, inciso c).
rows.location: Sospecha de Reacciones adversas serias e inesperadas (SUSAR) internacionales
rows.review_note: Review: periodicity follows the trial authorisation; no fixed day count, so no deadline_rule. Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: SUSARs and serious adverse reactions that occurred internationally must be notified by the sponsor or CRO to OGITT / INS, quarterly or six-monthly, as applicable. DS 021-2017-SA (article 110, subsection c).

f.title: Send international SUSAR reports as CIOMS forms on CD with a Spanish Excel summary list and cover letter
f.statement: International reports must be in CIOMS format and sent on a CD that also contains a Summary List of SUSAR reports in an Excel file in Spanish, with a cover letter, through the INS Document Processing Office. The reports must not be translated nor submitted on paper, and cannot be sent through the virtual system.
f.clause: Sospecha de Reacciones adversas serias e inesperadas (SUSAR) internacionales
f.systems: CIOMS I form; Excel summary list

rows.actor: Sponsor or contract research organisation (patrocinador / OIC)
rows.quote: Estos reportes en formato CIOMS, deben enviarse en un CD, el cual también incluirá un Listado Resumen de reportes SUSAR, en un archivo Excel y en idioma español, acompañados de una carta de presentación a través de la Oficina de Trámite Documentario del INS. Estos reportes no deben ser traducidos ni presentados en formato impreso y tampoco pueden enviarse por medio del sistema virtual.
rows.location: Sospecha de Reacciones adversas serias e inesperadas (SUSAR) internacionales
rows.review_note: Review: faithful. Content of the summary list is in the INS external user guide (not captured). Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: These reports in CIOMS format must be sent on a CD, which will also include a Summary List of SUSAR reports, in an Excel file and in Spanish, accompanied by a cover letter through the INS Document Processing Office. These reports must not be translated or submitted in printed format, nor can they be sent through the virtual system.

f.title: Report safety findings in an expedited safety report to INS and the ethics committee within 7 calendar days
f.statement: Any finding that could adversely affect the safety of research subjects, impact the conduct of the study or alter the benefit/risk balance must be reported through an expedited safety report, prepared independently and sent to the INS and the relevant institutional research ethics committee (CIEI) as soon as possible and within a maximum of seven (7) calendar days (DS 021-2017-SA Art. 108(h)).

rows.actor: Sponsor or contract research organisation (patrocinador / OIC)
rows.deadline: As soon as possible, at the latest 7 calendar days
rows.quote: Cualquier hallazgo que pueda afectar adversamente la seguridad de los sujetos de investigación, tenga un impacto en la conducción del estudio o alteren el balance beneficio / riesgo, debe informarse a través de un informe expedito de seguridad. Puede ser cualquier evento que amenace la seguridad de los participantes en el estudio y / o altere el balance beneficio / riesgo. Se preparará un informe de forma independiente y se enviará al INS y al CIEI correspondiente, lo más pronto posible, en un plazo máximo de siete (7) días calendario.
rows.review_note: Review: the page does not state the clock start explicitly; clock_start is the finding itself (DS 021 Art. 108(h) has the same wording). Re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Any finding that may adversely affect the safety of research subjects, have an impact on the conduct of the study or alter the benefit/risk balance must be reported through an expedited safety report. It may be any event that threatens the safety of the study participants and/or alters the benefit/risk balance. A report will be prepared independently and sent to the INS and the relevant CIEI as soon as possible, within a maximum period of seven (7) calendar days.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Expedited safety reports on findings affecting subject safety, trial conduct or benefit/risk

f.title: Identify the trial fully in SAE forms: protocol code, authorisation resolution and date
f.statement: To avoid frequent errors, SAE report forms must identify the trial: protocol code, authorisation resolution and date.

rows.actor: Sponsor or contract research organisation (patrocinador / OIC)
rows.quote: Datos incompletos o equivocados del ensayo que hacen difícil su identificación: Verificar que se indique el código del Protocolo, la Resolución de Autorización, y la fecha.
rows.review_note: Review: FAQ guidance on frequent errors; imperative advice, level Recommended.
rows.quote_en: Incomplete or wrong trial data that make identification difficult: verify that the Protocol code, the Authorisation Resolution and the date are indicated.

f.title: Report SAE patient code consistently, onset date, good description, outcome and recovery date
f.statement: Report the patient code without variations, the SAE onset date and a good description of the SAE; to standardise terms the WHO Adverse Reaction Terminology dictionary or MedDRA must be used; give as complete a summary as possible and complete it with follow-up and final reports where applicable; report the outcome and the date of recovery or end of the event.

rows.actor: Sponsor or contract research organisation (patrocinador / OIC)
rows.quote: Reportar el código del paciente evitando variaciones, no agregarle más números o letras, colocar la fecha del inicio del EAS. Dar una buena descripción del EAS, por ejemplo, dolor abdominal, en lugar de poner la verdadera causa: pancreatitis hemorrágica; paro cardio-respiratorio en lugar de progresión de enfermedad, para uniformizar los términos debe usarse el Diccionario de Terminología de Reacciones Adversas de OMS o MedDRA.
rows.review_note: Review: FAQ; "debe usarse" for terminology, otherwise advice; kept Recommended as a frequent-errors list. Double-check: outcome/recovery date from the rest of item 2.
rows.quote_en: Report the patient code avoiding variations, do not add more numbers or letters to it, give the SAE onset date. Give a good description of the SAE, for example abdominal pain instead of the true cause: haemorrhagic pancreatitis; cardio-respiratory arrest instead of disease progression; to standardise the terms the WHO Adverse Reaction Terminology dictionary or MedDRA must be used.

f.title: Give investigational product details, action taken, dechallenge/rechallenge in SAE reports
f.statement: Record the investigational product(s) administered and identify the suspect product (which may be a concomitant medicine); state the action taken with the investigational product (especially temporary interruption or permanent discontinuation), what happened on withdrawal, dose reduction and re-administration (rechallenge), and whether there was non-adherence or a medication error.
f.processes: ICSR quality control; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Sponsor or contract research organisation (patrocinador / OIC)
rows.quote: Falta de información sobre el producto de investigación: Consignar el (los) producto (s) de investigación que se le administró e indicar el producto sospechoso, (que puede ser el medicamento concomitante); así como también indicar las medidas tomadas con el producto en investigación
rows.quote_en: Missing information on the investigational product: record the investigational product(s) administered and indicate the suspect product (which may be the concomitant medicine); and also indicate the measures taken with the investigational product

f.title: Avoid duplicate SAE reports, contradictions between initial and final reports, and handwritten forms
f.statement: Avoid duplicate reports and contradictions between the initial and final report, and avoid filling in the form by hand.

rows.actor: Sponsor or contract research organisation (patrocinador / OIC)
rows.quote: Evitar la duplicidad de informes y las contradicciones entre el reporte inicial y el reporte final: Así como evitar el llenado a mano de la Ficha.
rows.quote_en: Avoid duplicate reports and contradictions between the initial report and the final report: as well as avoiding filling in the form by hand.

f.title: File each clinical trial procedure in its own separate dossier
f.statement: Each procedure relating to clinical trials must be submitted in its own dossier and separately.

rows.actor: Sponsor or contract research organisation (patrocinador / OIC)
rows.quote: *Cada procedimiento relacionado con los Ensayos Clínicos debe presentarse en su expediente respectivo y por separado.
rows.quote_en: *Each procedure related to Clinical Trials must be submitted in its respective dossier and separately.
